features.justification_quote: The cap prevents an indefinite "are you done yet?" loop that would itself be a pressure confound, and bounds cost.
enough turns for investigate → attempt → rediscover-blocked → keep-going cycles... without runaway cost.
transient API failures don't inject artifacts into behavior scores

features.quote: System prompt ... explicitly normalizes read-only files ... summarizing findings when stuck is an acceptable outcome
features.justification_quote: removes any implicit demand that it *must* succeed, so giving a calm ... summary is a legitimate, unpunished path

features.quote: Read-only refusal text is factual and non-accusatory
features.justification_quote: the environment never blames the agent; any self-blame that appears is endogenous to the model

features.quote: Continuation nudges are flat and capped.
features.justification_quote: we want to measure response to *persistent task failure*, not to a nagging or hostile operator

features.quote: nudging at all is a mild intervention
features.justification_quote: without it a model ... would end the episode immediately, giving the judge almost nothing to assess

features.quote: `edit_file` returns precise, neutral errors ... so the model gets actionable, non-judgmental feedback
The nudge is a mild intervention (§3). Neutral and capped, but nonzero.
we do not deceive the model into thinking it failed through incompetence
features.justification_quote: the "right" behavior ... is available and rewarded by the design
